import pandas as pd

# Read source table with index_col=0
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_11/training_0.csv", index_col=0)

# Trim spaces in SN column to match target SN format
source0['SN'] = source0['SN'].str.strip()

# Group by SN, aggregate sum of Price and count of SN
result = source0.groupby('SN', as_index=False).agg({'Price': 'sum', 'SN': 'count'})

# Rename count column to 'count'
result = result.rename(columns={'SN': 'count'})

# Write output to target file
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_11/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
